Kidney failure has six stages. Most men don't feel a thing until stage four. Stage one, the clog. Your kidneys have a million tiny filters called nephrons. Your kidneys also have their own drainage system called the renal lymphatic network that's supposed to clear waste away from these filters. Most of them get suffocated from years of waste backing up in their drainage system. And your kidneys can lose up to 70% of their function before you feel a single thing. Most people have no idea this is happening inside them right now. Stage two, the foam. Clogged filters leak protein into your urine. That's the foam. The bubbles that sit on top and don't disappear. Most men notice it, flush, and forget. It's the one warning you can actually see, and most men ignore it. Stage three, hyperfiltration. The silent stage, the most dangerous. Your remaining nephrons start working overtime to compensate for the ones you've lost. They push harder, filter faster. Your labs might still look okay. Your doctor says keep monitoring. But hyperfiltration is your kidneys burning themselves out trying to save you. Everything looks fine until it isn't. Stage four, the drop. After years of your kidneys getting overworked in stage three, your EGFR drops suddenly. Creatinine climbs. The numbers your doctor was monitoring suddenly look bad overnight, but the damage had been happening for years. The fatigue you blamed on aging? Kidney fatigue. The back pain that won't go away? Your kidneys swelling. Puffy face, brain fog, metallic taste. It all hits at once, because your kidneys can't compensate anymore. And now the decline isn't slow, it's fast. Stage five, the despair. You drank more water? Didn't work. Cut sodium? Didn't work. Took the medications? Didn't stop it. You did everything you were told, and it kept getting worse. Because nobody addressed the actual problem, the clog. And now your doctor says a word you never expected to hear. Dialysis. Stage six, the dialysis chair. Three times a week, four hours a session, $90,000 a year. Two companies control 70% of the industry. Your life revolves around a machine that does what your body was supposed to do. And most men in that chair wish they had done something when they first saw the foam. Most people think you can't improve your EGFR. And while it's true you can't revive dead nephrons, most of them aren't dead. They're just suffocating in waste back up. And clearing that drainage is simpler than you think. Four compounds work together to restore renal lymphatic drainage. Cleavers sweeps waste through backed up channels. Dandelion root flushes trapped debris. Burdock root purifies recirculating toxins. And bromelain breaks down proteins blocking drainage pathways. The problem is most kidney supplements don't target drainage. Generic kidney support formulas with cranberry and vitamin D that don't target renal lymphatic drainage. Sculpteek combines all four drainage compounds in clinical doses. Third party tested. Made in the USA. No fillers. 90 day result guarantee. If you're seeing foam right now, that's your window. Link is below. Comment which stage you're at.
